title: Hearing on the economic impact of the 2026 World Cup
summary: The Council held a joint oversight hearing examining New York City's costs and benefits from hosting 2026 FIFA World Cup matches, including city spending of about $90 million against roughly $51 million in projected tax revenue. The hearing also considered Resolution 655, which calls on FIFA to pay New York City the $1 million "legacy contribution" it promised host cities but reportedly has not paid.
